text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Hishi 
Miracle...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah! There are Paka Petit figures!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Hishi Miracle 
pointed, I saw a crane game filled with 
plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's so round and cute, isn't it~? It's 
really popular in my class, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“These are really tough, though. I've 
tried so many times, and I haven't gotten 
a single one...”
choice_data_list: Here, let me get it for you.
Then I'll get it for you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! I'll be cheering you 
on with all my might~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
